"""Join recorded acceptance and custody metadata only; no original validator import."""

R = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/bfccb8494ba0')
D = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = 'f97c5068d056969705e8387ba1f37d83847f5bee'
def read(p): return json.loads(p.read_text())
def meta(p):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    return dict(local_path=str(p),bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest())

    with (D/name).open('x') as f: json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')

reg=read(registry_path)
def key(plan):
    p=plan['profile_study'];profile=p['mutation_profile']
    return (profile,p['fanout'] if profile=='fanout' else plan['files'][0],plan['shard']['index'])
expected={key(p) for p in reg['plans']}
assert len(expected)==45 and reg['cell_count']==45 and reg['record_count']==85 and reg['source_commit']==SOURCE
sources=[
 ('R42-first12-intake','first12'),

raw_index=read(raw_index_path)
custody={tuple(c['slot']):c for c in raw_index['ordered_cells']}
assert len(custody)==len(raw_index['ordered_cells'])
assert raw_index['source']==SOURCE and raw_index['run_id']==38026411200 and raw_index['attempt']==1
accepted={}; inputs=[]; records=collections.Counter()
for directory,prefix in sources:
    base=R/directory;path=base/(prefix+'-original-intake-review.json');report=read(path)
    manifest_path=base/'sealed/upload-manifest.actual.json';manifest=read(manifest_path)
    assert report['source']==SOURCE and report['run_id']==38026411200 and report['attempt']==1
    report_row=next(x for x in manifest['files'] if pathlib.Path(x['local_path'])==path)
    support_row=next(x for x in manifest['files'] if x['local_path'].endswith('.zip'))
    for item in manifest['files']:
        assert item['actual_created'] is True
        assert item.get('actual_server_oid',item.get('server_sha'))==item['git_blob']
    observed=meta(path)
    assert all(observed[k]==report_row[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256','git_blob'])
    inputs.append(dict(report=report_row,actual_manifest=meta(manifest_path),support=support_row))
    for row in report['catalog']:
        slot=tuple(row['slot']);assert slot in expected and slot not in accepted and row['exit_code']==0
        roles=['fanout'] if slot[0]=='fanout' else ['setup','mutation']
        assert row['record_roles']==roles and row['record_count']==len(roles) and row['native_hash_calls']==2
        c=custody[slot];a=row['artifact'];w=row['whole_zip']
        assert (a['id'],a['name'],a['size_in_bytes'],a['digest'])==(c['artifact_id'],c['artifact_name'],c['whole_bytes'],'sha256:'+c['whole_sha256'])
        assert (w['bytes'],w['sha256'],w['git_blob'])==(c['whole_bytes'],c['whole_sha256'],c['computed_whole_git_blob'])
        assert a['workflow_run']['id']==38026411200 and a['workflow_run']['head_sha']==SOURCE
        offset=0
        for i,leaf in enumerate(c['ordered_original_byte_leaves']):
            assert leaf['index']==i and leaf['offset']==offset
            offset+=leaf['bytes']
        assert offset==c['whole_bytes']
        records.update(roles)
        accepted[slot]=dict(slot=list(slot),record_identities=[dict(slot=list(slot),role=r) for r in roles],record_sample_labels=row['record_sample_labels'],record_groups=row['record_groups'],environment=row['environment'],original_result=row['original_result'],original_execution_receipt=row['execution_receipt'],original_task_receipt_sha256=row['original_task_receipt_sha256'],original_shard_directory=row['original_shard_directory'],original_validator_exit=0,original_hash_calls_recorded=2,accepted_report=dict(git_blob=report_row['git_blob'],repository_path=report_row['repository_path'],sha256=report_row['sha256']),accepted_support=dict(git_blob=support_row['git_blob'],repository_path=support_row['repository_path']),whole_custody=c)
assert len(accepted)==43 and sum(records.values())==81
assert len(custody)==43 and set(custody)==set(accepted)
missing=sorted(expected-set(accepted))

write('accepted-43-original-receipt-custody-catalog.json',out)
write('attempt02-metadata-assembly-receipt.json',dict(exit_code=0,accepted_cells=43,accepted_records=81,missing_slots=out['missing_slots'],original_function_calls=0,whole_zip_or_raw_reads=0,ELF_calls=0,report=meta(D/'accepted-43-original-receipt-custody-catalog.json'),historical_attempt01_preserved=True,field_layout_bridge='actual_server_oid or historical server_sha, both checked against actual manifest git_blob; old manifests unchanged'))
print(json.dumps(dict(accepted_cells=43,accepted_records=81,roles=dict(records),missing_slots=out['missing_slots'],catalog=meta(D/'accepted-43-original-receipt-custody-catalog.json'))))
